decisive_spans.text: Bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement on MRI, without clear infectious cause

response.rationale: D3 is strongly supported by the MRI findings of bilateral iliacus and iliopsoas muscle oedema with enhancement, and the absence of a clear infectious cause. D4 is supported by elevated inflammatory markers and pre-renal acute-on-chronic kidney injury, but sepsis was not confirmed by other tests.
